_doc: T032 per-heir allocation oracle (TT-463), class-gift shape. Equal division of a fund among a class of beneficiaries — the flat no-repeat_by case (per_member_amounts is already one amount per heir, so no per-branch expansion). Proves the per_heir harness path generalises beyond the per-stirpes repeat_by shape. WARNING — INVERTED CASE: a case with "expect": "wrong_split" carries a DELIBERATELY WRONG expected_per_heir_gbp (right total, right count, wrong split); it is NOT the correct answer. The harness PASSES that case iff it correctly detects the split differs, and goes RED if the wrong split somehow matched (non-vacuous teeth). Equal-division shares are general-law arithmetic (fund / n); the oracle is the division rule itself, not an external published figure.
statute: General law: a class gift in equal shares divides the fund equally among the members of the class.

cases.label: wrong-split-100k-conserving
cases.note: DELIBERATELY WRONG (not the correct answer). Right total (£100,000) AND right heir-count (4) but the split is £40,000/£20,000/£20,000/£20,000 instead of the correct £25,000 each. The harness MUST detect that the split differs — the class-gift analogue of the C1 gameable-conservation case.
